source.original_text: The actual Gaussian on the midpoint cosine spectrum has the following two exact means. Both integrands are integrable. M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2=\frac d{\sqrt\kappa}\frac{1-r^{2d}}{1+r^{2d}},\qquad(-1)^n\mu_n=(-1)^n\mathbb E[U^\top D_nU]=\frac d{\sqrt\kappa}\frac{r^n-r^{2d-n}}{1+r^{2d}}. Fix \(d\in\mathbb N\), \(d\ge2\), \(\kappa\in\mathbb R\), \(\kappa\ge2\), and \(n\in\mathbb N\) with \(1\le n<d\). For \(i=1,\ldots,d\), set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+((\kappa-1)/2)\cos\theta_i\), and \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\). Lean uses \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d\) and \((i.\mathrm{val}+1/2)\pi/d\). Let \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\) on real Euclidean space and \(D_n=\operatorname{diag}(\cos(n\theta_i))\). The literal Gaussian constructor takes covariance \(\Lambda^{-1}\); \(\Lambda\) is precision. Its coordinate quadratic form is \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\). Set \(r=(\sqrt\kappa-1)/(\sqrt\kappa+1)\), \(M=\int\|x\|^2\,d\mu\), and \(\mu_n=\int Q(x)\,d\mu\), where \(\mu=N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\). The inequalities \(0<r<1\), all denominator conditions and both integrability facts are proved internally.

    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnd : n < d),
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)
  let Λ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal eigenvalue
  let μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :=
    multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) Λ⁻¹
  let Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x =>
    ∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp x i) ^ 2
  let r : ℝ := (Real.sqrt κ - 1) / (Real.sqrt κ + 1)
  Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => ‖x‖ ^ 2) μ ∧
  Integrable Q μ ∧
  (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
    ((d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) * ((1 - r ^ (2 * d)) / (1 + r ^ (2 * d))) ∧
  (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Q x ∂μ) =
    ((d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) * ((r ^ n - r ^ (2 * d - n)) / (1 + r ^ (2 * d)))

For every natural number d with d ≥ 2, every real number κ with κ ≥ 2, and every natural number n with 1 ≤ n < d, define, for each coordinate index i ∈ {0, …, d − 1},

θᵢ = (i + 1/2)π/d,
λᵢ = (κ + 1)/2 + ((κ − 1)/2) cos θᵢ.

Let Λ = diag(λ₀, …, λ_{d−1}). On the real Euclidean space Rᵈ, let μ be the centered multivariate Gaussian measure with covariance matrix Λ⁻¹. More explicitly, μ is the image of the standard Gaussian measure under the linear map whose matrix is the positive semidefinite square root of Λ⁻¹. Define the real-valued function

Q(x) = ∑_{i=0}^{d−1} cos(nθᵢ) xᵢ²

and the real number

r = (√κ − 1)/(√κ + 1).

Then x ↦ ‖x‖² and Q are both Bochner integrable with respect to μ, and their real Bochner integrals satisfy the two exact identities

∫_{Rᵈ} ‖x‖² dμ(x) = (d/√κ) (1 − r^{2d})/(1 + r^{2d}),

(−1)ⁿ ∫_{Rᵈ} Q(x) dμ(x) = (d/√κ) (rⁿ − r^{2d−n})/(1 + r^{2d}).

Here ‖·‖ is the standard Euclidean norm, all coordinate sums include every index from 0 through d − 1, and all displayed angles and scalar expressions are real. Powers have natural-number exponents. The expression 2d − n uses natural subtraction, which is ordinary nonnegative subtraction under 1 ≤ n < d. Matrix and real inverses and the real square root retain the totalized meanings in the supplied context. In this parameter range every λᵢ is positive, so Λ⁻¹ is the usual inverse and the Gaussian parameter is its ordinary positive definite covariance. The Gaussian construction agrees with the supplied totalized definition, whose matrix square root is zero outside the positive semidefinite domain; the assumptions here stay within that domain.

The assertions hold separately for every admissible triple (d, κ, n). Both integrability conclusions and both equalities concern this same μ, and Q depends on n as defined above. There is no limiting, asymptotic, approximate, almost-everywhere, or optimization assertion and no unspecified constant. All numerical factors are displayed explicitly; μ depends on d and κ, the formula for Q depends only on d and n, while its integration measure also depends on κ, and r depends only on κ.

private def signedAlias (D : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  if (D : ℤ) ∣ k then (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k / (D : ℤ)) else 0

private theorem signedAlias_norm (D : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : ‖signedAlias D k‖ ≤ 1 := by
  unfold signedAlias
  split_ifs <;> simp

private theorem signedAlias_period {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (k : ℤ) :
    signedAlias D (k + D) = -signedAlias D k := by
  have hDne : (D : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hD)
  have hdiv : (k + (D : ℤ)) / (D : ℤ) = k / (D : ℤ) + 1 := by
    simpa using Int.add_mul_ediv_right k 1 hDne
  have hdvd : ((D : ℤ) ∣ k + (D : ℤ)) ↔ (D : ℤ) ∣ k :=
    dvd_add_left (dvd_refl (D : ℤ))
  by_cases hk : (D : ℤ) ∣ k
  · simp only [signedAlias, hdvd, hk, if_true]
    rw [hdiv, zpow_add_one₀ (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
    ring
  · simp [signedAlias, hdvd, hk]

private theorem summable_signedAlias (D : ℕ) {q : ℝ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (c : ℤ) :
    Summable (fun j : ℕ => q ^ (j + 1) * signedAlias D (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - c)) := by
  have hg : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ‖q‖ ^ (j + 1)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg q) hq)
  have hbound (j : ℕ) :
      ‖q ^ (j + 1) * signedAlias D (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - c)‖ ≤ ‖q‖ ^ (j + 1) := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (signedAlias_norm D _) (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)).trans_eq (mul_one _)
  exact (Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => norm_nonneg _) hbound hg).of_norm

private theorem offset_alias_tsum {D c : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hcD : c ≤ D)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, q ^ (j + 1) * signedAlias D (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))) =
      q ^ c / (1 + q ^ D) := by
  classical
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => q ^ (j + 1) * signedAlias D (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (c : ℤ))
  let emb : ℕ → ℕ := fun a => D * a + (c - 1)
  have hDpos : (0 : ℤ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hDne : (D : ℤ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hDpos
  have hinj : Function.Injective emb := by
    intro a b h
    change D * a + (c - 1) = D * b + (c - 1) at h
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.ne_of_gt hD) (Nat.add_right_cancel h)
  have hsupport : Function.support f ⊆ Set.range emb := by
    intro j hj
    change f j ≠ 0 at hj
    have hdiv : (D : ℤ) ∣ ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (c : ℤ) := by
      by_contra hn
      have ha0 : signedAlias D (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) = 0 := by
        simp only [signedAlias, if_neg hn]
      apply hj
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [ha0, mul_zero]
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hdiv
    have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := by
      by_contra hn
      have hzneg : z ≤ -1 := by omega
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzneg hDpos.le
      have hcint : (c : ℤ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast hcD
      have hjint : (0 : ℤ) < ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
      nlinarith
    have hcast : (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = (D : ℤ) * (z.toNat : ℤ) + (c : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz0]
      linarith
    have hjnat : j + 1 = D * z.toNat + c := by exact_mod_cast hcast
    refine ⟨z.toNat, ?_⟩
    dsimp [emb]
    omega
  have hterm (a : ℕ) : f (emb a) = q ^ c * (-q ^ D) ^ a := by
    have he : emb a + 1 = D * a + c := by dsimp [emb]; omega
    have hcast : (((D * a + c : ℕ) : ℤ) - (c : ℤ)) = (D : ℤ) * (a : ℤ) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    have ha : signedAlias D ((D : ℤ) * (a : ℤ)) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ a := by
      unfold signedAlias
      rw [if_pos (dvd_mul_right _ _), Int.ediv_eq_of_eq_mul_right hDne rfl]
      simp
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [he, hcast, ha, pow_add, pow_mul, neg_pow]
    ring
  have hratio : ‖-q ^ D‖ < 1 := by
    rw [norm_neg, norm_pow]
    exact pow_lt_one₀ (norm_nonneg q) hq (Nat.ne_of_gt hD)
  have hgeom := summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hratio
  calc
    (∑' j : ℕ, f j) = ∑' a : ℕ, f (emb a) := (hinj.tsum_eq hsupport).symm
    _ = ∑' a : ℕ, q ^ c * (-q ^ D) ^ a := tsum_congr hterm
    _ = q ^ c * (∑' a : ℕ, (-q ^ D) ^ a) := hgeom.tsum_mul_left _
    _ = q ^ c / (1 + q ^ D) := by
      rw [tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hratio, sub_neg_eq_add, div_eq_mul_inv]


private theorem inverse_grid_alias_series {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 ≤ κ) (ℓ : ℤ) :
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)
  let r : ℝ := (Real.sqrt κ - 1) / (Real.sqrt κ + 1)
  let a : ℤ → ℝ := signedAlias (2 * d)
  let F : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (-r) ^ (j + 1) *
    (a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ℓ) + a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + ℓ))

  (∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((ℓ : ℝ) * θ i) / eigenvalue i) =
    ((d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) * (a ℓ + ∑' j : ℕ, F j) := by

  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)
  let r : ℝ := (Real.sqrt κ - 1) / (Real.sqrt κ + 1)
  let a : ℤ → ℝ := signedAlias (2 * d)
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos ((ℓ : ℝ) * θ i)
  let f : Fin d → ℕ → ℝ := fun i j =>
    (-r) ^ (j + 1) * Real.cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let g : Fin d → ℕ → ℝ := fun i j =>
    (-r) ^ (j + 1) * (w i * Real.cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i))
  let G : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ∑ i : Fin d, g i j
  let F : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (-r) ^ (j + 1) *
    (a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ℓ) + a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + ℓ))
  change Summable F → (∑ i : Fin d, w i / eigenvalue i) =

    dsimp [eigenvalue]
    have h := mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ κ - 1)
      (by linarith [Real.neg_one_le_cos (θ i)] : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.cos (θ i))
    nlinarith

    simpa only [a, signedAlias, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using

      simpa only [w, Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_cos_le_one ((ℓ : ℝ) * θ i)
    calc

        dsimp [g, f]
        ring

    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => norm_nonneg _) (hmajor i) (habs (θ i))
  have hsg (i : Fin d) : Summable (g i) := (hsgnorm i).of_norm
  have hsumG : Summable G := summable_sum (fun i _ => hsg i)

      2 * (∑ i : Fin d, w i * Real.cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)) =
      (d : ℝ) * (a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ℓ) +

  have hlin (i : Fin d) : (∑' j : ℕ, g i j) = w i * (∑' j : ℕ, f i j) := by

      _ = _ := (hs i).tsum_mul_left (w i)
  have heigen (i : Fin d) : (eigenvalue i)⁻¹ =
      (1 / Real.sqrt κ) * (1 + 2 * ∑' j : ℕ, f i j) := by
    have htwice : 2 * eigenvalue i = κ + 1 + (κ - 1) * Real.cos (θ i) := by

      ring
    have hrecip : (eigenvalue i)⁻¹ = 2 / (κ + 1 + (κ - 1) * Real.cos (θ i)) := by
      have hi0 : eigenvalue i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (heigenlower i))
      rw [← htwice]
      field_simp [hi0]
    exact hrecip.trans (heq (θ i))
  have hscalar (i : Fin d) : w i / eigenvalue i =
      (1 / Real.sqrt κ) * (w i + 2 * ∑' j : ℕ, g i j) := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, heigen, hlin]
    ring
  have hexchange : (∑' j : ℕ, G j) = ∑ i : Fin d, ∑' j : ℕ, g i j :=
    Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun i _ => hsg i)
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin d, (1 / Real.sqrt κ) * (w i + 2 * ∑' j : ℕ, g i j) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hscalar i)

    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg κ, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ κ)]

  have hr1 : r < 1 := by

    apply (div_lt_one (by linarith : 0 < Real.sqrt κ + 1)).2

    have hnot : ¬ (2 * d : ℤ) ∣ (n : ℤ) := by
      intro h

  let b : ℝ := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Q x ∂μ
  change 0 < m ∧ m ≤ (d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ ∧ 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * b ∧
    |b| / m = r ^ n * ((1 - r ^ (2 * (d - n))) / (1 - r ^ (2 * d)))
  have hclosed := actual_diagonal_gaussian_exact_means hd hκ n hn hnd
  have hm : m = ((d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) *
      ((1 - r ^ (2 * d)) / (1 + r ^ (2 * d))) := hclosed.2.2.1
  have hb : (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * b = ((d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) *
      ((r ^ n - r ^ (2 * d - n)) / (1 + r ^ (2 * d))) := hclosed.2.2.2
  have hsqrt : 1 < Real.sqrt κ := by
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg κ, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ κ)]
  have hr0 : 0 < r := div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hr1 : r < 1 := by
    dsimp [r]
    apply (div_lt_one (by linarith : 0 < Real.sqrt κ + 1)).2
    linarith
  have hscale : 0 < (d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ :=
    div_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < d)) (by linarith)
  have hτ0 : 0 ≤ r ^ (2 * d) := pow_nonneg hr0.le _
  have hτ1 : r ^ (2 * d) < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hr0.le hr1 (by omega)
  have hden : 0 < 1 + r ^ (2 * d) := by positivity
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by rw [hm]; exact mul_pos hscale (div_pos (by linarith) hden)
  have hmupper : m ≤ (d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ := by
    rw [hm]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hscale.le ((div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith))
  have hgap : n + 2 * (d - n) = 2 * d - n := by omega
  have hfactor : r ^ n - r ^ (2 * d - n) = r ^ n * (1 - r ^ (2 * (d - n))) := by
    rw [← hgap, pow_add]
    ring
  have hsmall : r ^ (2 * (d - n)) < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hr0.le hr1 (by omega)
  have hbpos : 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * b := by
    rw [hb, hfactor]
    exact mul_pos hscale (div_pos (mul_pos (pow_pos hr0 _) (by linarith)) hden)
  have habs : |b| = (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * b := by
    calc
      |b| = |(-1 : ℝ) ^ n * b| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_neg_one_pow, one_mul]
      _ = _ := abs_of_pos hbpos
  refine ⟨hmpos, hmupper, hbpos, ?_⟩
  rw [habs, hb, hm, hfactor]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hscale, ne_of_gt hden, ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < 1 - r ^ (2 * d))]
